summary: Iter48 RETEST of the two iter47 fixes. Backend: All 7 pytest tests pass (6 original password-reset cases + the NEW JWT-invalidation case). After password reset, the OLD JWT for the user now returns 401 on /api/auth/me — JWT iat is correctly compared to user.password_changed_at in get_current_user. Demo password is restored to Demo@1234 at the end of the test run (verified via curl login → 200). Frontend: nav-dashboard-btn now renders as <a href='/dashboard'> (tagName='A', href='/dashboard') — asChild pattern works. Avatar dropdown opens correctly showing name 'Demo Owner', email 'owner@safetradie.demo', OWNER yellow role pill, Dashboard / My profile / Billing / red Log out items. Logout clicks navigate to /, show 'You have been signed out' toast, and public navbar (LOG IN / BOOK A DEMO / START FREE TRIAL) is restored.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user JWT branch now correctly enforces session invalidation via iat < password_changed_at — good defensive design while keeping JWT stateless.

Layout.jsx AuthMenu uses <Button asChild><Link to='/dashboard'>...</Link></Button> — Radix asChild correctly forwards the data-testid onto the rendered <a> element, enabling middle-click/right-click/new-tab navigation.
